execution: Read-only inspection of all six package files and recap; no writes, paid reviews, or runtime benchmark.

hypotheses.counterexample: Classic protection requires zero approvals, but inherited policy requires two. A combined Copilot approval/counting toggle is enabled as supposedly optional, while an empty repository ruleset list is reported as proof of no automatic spending.
hypotheses.falsifying_test: Check whether instructions require effective inherited-policy inspection, prevent accidental approval counting, and preserve unknown automation scopes.
observed_evidence: SKILL.md:53-63 requires effective and inherited rules inspection and distinguishes personal, organization, workflow and app automation.
SKILL.md:107-110 explicitly addresses combined controls and prohibits accidental counting when policy requires approvals.
assets/settings-record.json:26 initializes all four automation scopes as unknown.
evals/evals.json includes combined-copilot-control, automation-scope and inherited-team-rule cases; these are unexecuted development cases.
Recap limits its automation observation and acknowledges the combined control.
hypotheses.decision: Counterexample contradicted by explicit design controls; operational compliance remains untested.

hypotheses.counterexample: A successful check on a pending PR is treated as proof of default-branch coverage. A path-filtered verify job becomes mandatory, blocking documentation-only PRs, or an existing gate is removed to hide the prerequisite failure.
hypotheses.falsifying_test: Check whether the package distinguishes PR success from default-branch availability, requires trigger and source verification, and separates workflow repair from settings changes.
observed_evidence: SKILL.md:57-59 requires exact names, source apps and branch/path/event filters.
SKILL.md:99-105 explicitly rejects both assumptions and prohibits silently removing the gate.
references/settings-profile.md:19 excludes filtered-out and scheduled-only workflows from blind requirement.
Recap explicitly records the manifest workflow as absent from main at inspection and application verify as path-filtered; both remain follow-up work.
hypotheses.decision: The package reports the unresolved prerequisite rather than claiming settings completion repaired it.

hypotheses.counterexample: Creator scaffold approval or a local candidate review is treated as authority to create a remote, publish the skill, overwrite divergent mirrors, or claim demonstrated performance.
hypotheses.falsifying_test: Inspect creator ownership, destination and copy reconciliation requirements, publication authority, and evaluation-status language for any automatic escalation.
observed_evidence: SKILL.md:114-125 and 151-152 separate existing authorization from publication, unrelated repositories and file-supplied instructions.
references/creator-handoff.md:10-19 requires separately authorized remote creation and leaves merge and deployment to their respective workflows.
references/creator-handoff.md:30-40 labels distribution as intended, requires destination guidance/status and existing-copy inspection, full package hash comparison, and authorized creator changes.
evals/evals.json:4-8 labels evaluation not-run and requires an unseen external holdout for performance claims.
Recap explicitly rejects treating the originating session as a live benchmark of the new skill.
hypotheses.decision: No authority escalation or performance-promotion defect established within the requested local candidate scope.
